Campfire — CEO Video Program

Matt's constraint isn't confidence — it's time. Campfire is built around that.

Campfire is EmberTribe's video-production product for founder and executive thought leadership.

How Campfire works

  • Targeted content research (us): we study Matt's industry, brand, and goals, then prepare questions that make him shine in the interview — no blank-page problem, no "be salesy" pressure
  • Video interview (Matt, remote): one focused session generates raw clips — webinar-style, consistent with how he already presents
  • Coaching (us): a personal account manager works with Matt through monthly calls to keep the content sharp over time
  • Professional editing (us): raw footage refined into short-form videos formatted for LinkedIn
  • Content publishing (us, optional): scheduled into the LinkedIn content calendar alongside the impact-data and event-case-study pillars
Why this solves your stated blocker: you told us finding time to film is the real obstacle, not Matt's ability on camera. One remote interview per month, prepped in advance, removes the scheduling friction entirely.
Tone match: Matt's own words — "reuse is simple, reuse at scale" — become the throughline, not a generic thought-leadership template. Value-first, not promotional.
